name: coremodel
description: Picks the model and the effort level each prompt needs, for code and office work; asks before Fable, xhigh or max, and names the token cost of a model switch mid-chat.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: suggest: ask before every switch of model or level. auto: switch by itself, but ask before Fable, xhigh, max and a model change mid-chat. off: do nothing.

classifier.title: Classifier model
classifier.description: The model that reads each prompt and picks the model and level: sonnet (more accurate) or haiku (faster, cheaper).

models.title: Models
models.description: Which models CoreModel may pick, comma-separated: haiku, sonnet, opus, fable. Remove a model your plan does not include.

pickModel.title: Pick the model
pickModel.description: on: pick the model and the effort. off: pick the effort only, as CoreEffort did.
